requirements.text: The bidder must hold a valid ISO 27001 information security management certification.
The bidder must hold a valid ISO 9001 quality management certification.
The bidder must have completed at least two enterprise network or data-centre projects each valued at not less than PKR 30 million during the last five years.
The bidder must be registered with the Federal Board of Revenue and hold active taxpayer (ATL) status.
The bidder must furnish bid security equal to 2% of the quoted price in the form of a bank guarantee or CDR from a scheduled bank.
All active equipment shall be from a single OEM and the bidder shall hold a valid partner or reseller authorisation.
The bidder should provide OEM certifications for the assigned engineers.
The bidder should propose a redundant core design with no single point of failure and demonstrate a documented high-availability methodology.
The bidder should provide a centralised network monitoring and management platform with alerting and reporting dashboards.
The bidder should commit to a 24x7 helpdesk with a four-hour on-site response time for critical incidents during the warranty period.
The bidder should provide a structured knowledge-transfer and training programme for the PITB network operations team.
The bidder must submit the quotation with a validity period of 90 days.

Quotations shall be submitted in a single sealed envelope containing one original and one copy addressed to the Director (Procurement), Punjab Information Technology Board, Arfa Software Technology Park, Lahore.
